context: A mom and son chat about a trip
purpose: Teach: 成田空港/読み手/ドラム缶/ローラ/滑る/解ける/歌え/見入っ

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、成田空港、初めてだよね、ぼく。
lines.en: Mom, this is my first time at Narita Airport.
lines.style: Bright, quick excitement. Slightly breathless on the opening. Small-boy energy — wants confirmation, wants her to know he's noticed something big.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。絵本の読み手、上手ね、翔くん。
lines.en: Yes. You read that picture book so nicely, Sho.
lines.style: Warm and observant. Soft voice, gentle acknowledgment. A small smile in the tone — she's noticing something he did well and wants him to feel seen.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 公園のドラム缶、夏は熱かった!
lines.en: That drum barrel in the park was so hot in the summer!
lines.style: Sudden, vivid memory. Faster pace. A little wonder in the voice — he's jumping to something bright he remembers. Unselfconscious child energy.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ローラースケート、まだ、苦手?
lines.en: Are you still having trouble with roller-skating?
lines.style: Gentle inquiry. Quiet, interested tone — not pressing, just checking in. The cadence of someone who listens more than she speaks.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん。坂で、すぐ滑るから、怖い。
lines.en: Yeah. I slide too fast when I go down the slope, so it's scary.
lines.style: Honest and small. Matter-of-fact about the fear without shame. The voice of a child saying something true. Slight hesitation before 'scary' — he's admitting something real.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 宿題、自分で解ける問題、増えたね。
lines.en: You're solving more of your homework problems on your own now.
lines.style: Quiet pride. Understated. She's observing progress without making a show of it. Warmth beneath the simplicity — she notices the small growing-ups.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 運動会、お友達と一緒に歌えるの、楽しみ!
lines.en: I'm really looking forward to singing with my friends at the sports day.
lines.style: Pure anticipation. Brighter than before. Unselfconscious joy — he's imagining something good and can't hide it. Light, airy delivery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 絵本、最後まで見入ってたね、可愛かった。
lines.en: You were so absorbed in that picture book all the way to the end. It was adorable.
lines.style: Soft, tender closing. The voice of someone looking back on a moment just passed. Warmth without sentimentality. A mother's quiet affection settling into words.
